text: Use adjectives and adverbs followed by adjectives.

text: Adjectives are words that describe nouns. Nouns can be people, places, things, or ideas.

text: Which words are nouns. Which are adjectives?

text: Statements with present forms of be are followed by adjectives.

text: Can I say: Small towns is really safe?
